title: President Trump hosted a dinner on Sunday for the top $TRUMP collectors; an analysis finds the entry cost was as low as $518, down from its $55K peak in 2025 (Isaac Arnsdorf/Washington Post)
summary: Isaac Arnsdorf / Washington Post: President Trump hosted a dinner on Sunday for the top $TRUMP collectors; an analysis finds the entry cost was as low as $518, down from its $55K peak in 2025 — The president presided over an upscale dinner for investors in his collapsing meme coin, celebrating the venture even as the price of admission has plummeted.
